'''Guardian Hold One''' was a bunker in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was one of the [[Guardian Holds]], special fortified installations throughout the [[City/Legends|city]].
